module: Native gradients — engine, rasterizer and GRD presets
status: Foundation qualified; editable fill workflow now implemented in follow-up; live/Classic tools and exact Photoshop 2026 coverage remain open

primary_references.scope: On-canvas endpoints, color stops, midpoint controls and preset saving; updated August 18, 2026
Source ramp, handles and deterministic dither
Source-inferred whole-pixel endpoints for Linear and Reflected
Source-fitted Classic/sRGB, Linear/linear-light, Perceptual/Oklab and Catmull-Rom smoothness. Native evaluates retained controls directly instead of baking 97 stops.
Version 5 preset file and stop encoding

Independent format identifier cross-check: gradientInterpolationMethodType; Perc, Lnr and Gcls; gs99 layer-style key versus gradientsInterpolationMethod gradient-content key. Reference-only format facts, not imported code.

implementation: Five styles: Linear, Radial, Angle, Reflected, Diamond; scale, angle, offset, reverse, snapped or unsnapped endpoints, reversible handles
Independent retained color and opacity stops, segment midpoints, smoothness, Classic/Linear/Perceptual interpolation; dynamic foreground/background colors captured explicitly
RGB, HSB and grayscale stop models retained through native and GRD interchange
Region-aware cancellable RGB/8/16/32 rasterizer with document-coordinate deterministic dither
Bounded GRD v5 decoding, source-exact unchanged encoding, fresh native writer, nested phry folders, preservation of unavailable preset records with explicit reasons

evidence.legacy_endpoint_difference: Two values differ by one Float32 ULP in the final green endpoint before/after dither. Native preserves the specified endpoint exactly, matching the source PSD interpolation evaluator; legacy Ramp interpolates it and rounds it. This is a recorded divergence, not a byte-exact legacy Ramp claim.

next_integration_order: Add editable Gradient Fill document content and commands, archive/clipboard support, masks and stable layer/canvas geometry; implement GdFl PSD import/export without baking the retained controls.
Connect G/Shift-G live and Classic Gradient modes, on-canvas endpoints/stops/midpoints/transparency, Properties, Gradient Editor, fill menus, preview/cancel/undo and Gradients preset folders.
Port Gradient Map and layer-style gradient overlays/strokes, then noise gradients and profile-correct CMYK/Lab behavior.

Capture Photoshop 2026 operations/files and compare exact pixels and settings at all three depths, including selection/mask boundaries, duplicates, transparency, smoothness, scale and dither. Verify shortcuts and the full macOS platform matrix.
limitations: Editable Gradient Fill menus, native controls and GdFl are now implemented; see GRADIENT_FILL_REFERENCES.json for scope. Live and Classic tools remain pending.
The new GRD library API is not yet connected to a persistent user preset panel.
CMYK/Lab/noise gradients remain unavailable in the native gradient renderer; source records are retained rather than approximated.
Photoshop UI inspection remains blocked by the locked Mac. Source oracles are not Photoshop rasterization proof.
High-depth, interpolation, midpoint and dither equivalence to Photoshop 2026 is unverified. Source-derived exactness is tested only on this Apple Silicon host.
GRD locations and midpoints quantize to 1/4096 and 1/100 when a changed preset is encoded; native Codable controls retain Float values.
Additional method codes such as Smoo are explicitly unavailable; their Photoshop 2026 behavior must be inspected and ported rather than interpreted as Classic.
subsequent_gradient_map_milestone: See GRADIENT_MAP_REFERENCES.json for native pixel/layer workflows, presets and grdm support plus current Photoshop comparisons. Remaining lists here describe this earlier milestone.
